SELECT serial_no AS serialNo, -- 排序号 dept_code AS deptCode, -- 科室编码 dept_name AS deptName, -- 科室名称 dept_alias AS deptAlias, -- 科室别名 clinic_attr AS clinicAttr, -- 临床属性(0临床/1辅诊/2护理单元/3机关/9其他) outp_or_inp AS outpOrInp, -- 门诊住院标志(0门诊/1住院/2两者/9其他) internal_or_sergery AS internalOrSergery, -- 内外科标志(0内科/1外科) input_code AS inputCode, -- 输入码 type_code AS typeCode, -- 科室类型 group_unit_name AS groupUnitName -- 所属单元 FROM TR_DEPT_DICT
outp_or_inp IN (0, 2) and internal_or_sergery = 0
outp_or_inp IN (1, 2)
outp_or_inp = 9
outp_or_inp IN (0, 1, 2, 9)
AND dept_code = #{deptCode}
AND (dept_name LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%' OR dept_alias LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%')
ORDER BY serial_no, dept_code
